title: Ice age jumps

data.source: NGRIP oxygen-isotope record, 50-year means (North Greenland Ice Core Project members 2004), NOAA World Data Service for Paleoclimatology, doi:10.25921/g2m5-qd24
data.licence: Public (NOAA/WDS Paleoclimatology archive; free to use with citation)

prediction: The waits between sudden warmings are more even than memoryless waits, with a coefficient of variation below the 5th percentile of chance (P1); and a longer wait goes with a bigger jump (P2).
baseline: Memoryless (exponential) waits; shuffled order; and a 1,470-year clock.
why: The waits between the sudden warmings were no more even than memoryless waits would be. On this record there is no sign of a count running up to each jump.
